Chat completion via Azure OpenAI with the azure/ prefix for provider routing — verifies the prefix is stripped before dispatching and the response is normalised to the standard OpenAI chat completion shape

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _request = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"max_tokens\":16,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"azure/gpt-4\",\"temperature\":0}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chat(request: _request)
print(result)
```
